result.instructions: Tools for Schedule It, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is on the schedule this week, and who is it assigned to?"; "Create an event 'Site visit - Harper' tomorrow 09:00-11:00 for resource 220."; "Which events changed since yesterday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Schedule It data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run scheduleit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scheduleit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scheduleit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. scheduleit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List scheduled events and tasks (bookings, shifts, jobs). Without date_from/date_to Schedule It uses its default date range. Schedule It returns only a short summary of each event unless you name the fields you want: pass `fields` such as id,title,date_start,date_end,owner,notes,completed,priority,custom1 (get_event returns ALL fields of one event). `owner` holds the ids of the resources (people, rooms, equipment) the event is linked to. There is no paging: the reply holds up to `limit` events (default 100), so narrow with the filters instead. Do not call this repeatedly to watch for changes (use modified_after to fetch only what changed). GET /api/events.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,title,date_start,date_end,owner.

title.description: Events whose title contains this text.

resource_ids.description: Only events linked to these resources (see resource_match).

resource_match.description: With resource_ids: any = linked to at least one (default), all = linked to every one, none = linked to none of them.

tasks_only.description: true = only tasks, false = only events that are not tasks.

no_date_only.description: true = only events with no date, false = only dated ones.

modified_after.description: Only events added or changed after this date (yyyy-mm-dd) or date and time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (Account Settings > Workspaces). Omit for the main workspace (id 1).

tools.name: scheduleit_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event or task by id with ALL its fields (title, dates, linked resources, notes, completion, priority, custom fields). GET /api/events/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_event
tools.title: Create event
tools.description: WRITE: create a new event (booking, shift, job or task) in the Schedule It account, optionally linked to resources. It becomes visible to everyone with access to the schedule, and Schedule It may notify the linked resources according to the account's own notification settings. Confirm the title, dates and resources with the user first. POST /api/events.

resource_ids.description: Resources (people, rooms, equipment) the event is linked to (the `owner` field). On update this REPLACES the whole list.

notes.description: Notes. On update an empty string clears them.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed custom1..custom9 (the account's custom field labels are set in Schedule It). An empty string clears a field.

tools.name: scheduleit_update_event
tools.title: Update event
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are changed, the rest stay as they are. Passing resource_ids replaces the whole list of linked resources; an empty string clears notes or a custom field. Changing dates or resources may notify people per the account's notification settings. POST /api/events/{id}.

resource_ids.description: Resources (people, rooms, equipment) the event is linked to (the `owner` field). On update this REPLACES the whole list.

notes.description: Notes. On update an empty string clears them.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed custom1..custom9 (the account's custom field labels are set in Schedule It). An empty string clears a field.

tools.name: scheduleit_delete_event
tools.title: Delete event
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: permanently delete one event or task. It cannot be undone through the API. Only call this when the user clearly asked for this event to be deleted. DELETE /api/events/{id}.

event_id.description: Schedule It event id to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user confirmed this event should be permanently deleted.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List resources: the people, rooms, equipment or vehicles that events are scheduled against. Schedule It returns only a short summary unless you pass `fields` (for example id,name,email,data1; get_resource returns ALL fields of one). Resources belong to groups (`owner` = group ids). There is no paging; the reply holds up to `limit` resources (default 100). GET /api/resources.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,email.

name.description: Resources whose name contains this text.

modified_after.description: Only resources added or changed after this date (yyyy-mm-dd) or date and time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (Account Settings > Workspaces). Omit for the main workspace (id 1).

tools.name: scheduleit_get_resource
tools.title: Get resource
tools.description: One resource by id with ALL its fields (name, email, groups, details 1-10, colours, skills). GET /api/resources/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_resource
tools.title: Create resource
tools.description: WRITE: add a new resource (a person, room, piece of equipment) to the Schedule It account. It may count toward the account's licensed resources or users. Confirm the details with the user first. POST /api/resources.

group_ids.description: Groups the resource belongs to (the `owner` field). On update this REPLACES the whole list.

email.description: Email address of the resource (an empty string clears it on update).

details.description: Detail values keyed data1..data10 (for example data1 = job title; the labels are set in Schedule It). An empty string clears a field.

color_event_back.description: Background colour of this resource's events.

tools.name: scheduleit_update_resource
tools.title: Update resource
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing resource; only the fields you pass are changed. Passing group_ids replaces the whole list of groups; an empty string clears email or a detail field. POST /api/resources/{id}.

group_ids.description: Groups the resource belongs to (the `owner` field). On update this REPLACES the whole list.

email.description: Email address of the resource (an empty string clears it on update).

details.description: Detail values keyed data1..data10 (for example data1 = job title; the labels are set in Schedule It). An empty string clears a field.

color_event_back.description: Background colour of this resource's events.

tools.name: scheduleit_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List resource groups (the categories resources are organised in, e.g. Staff, Rooms, Vehicles). Pass `fields` (e.g. id,name) for more than the short summary. GET /api/groups.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name.

name.description: Groups whose name contains this text.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (Account Settings > Workspaces). Omit for the main workspace (id 1).

tools.name: scheduleit_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: One resource group by id with ALL its fields. GET /api/groups/{id}.

tools.name: scheduleit_create_group
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: WRITE: add a new resource group to the Schedule It account. POST /api/groups.

position.description: Position of the group in the schedule (positionv).

min_resources.description: Fewest resources an event needs from this group (0 = no minimum).

max_resources.description: Most resources an event can use from this group (0 = no limit).

hide_from_main.description: Hide the group from the main schedule view.

hide_from_event.description: Hide the group from the event form.
